description: Realistic Insimul quest predicates whose shapes come from packages/core/src/prolog/predicate-schema.ts (quest/5, quest_objective/3, quest_reward/3, quest_prerequisite/2) plus derived gameplay rules (availability, difficulty projection, objective completion, reward gating). Each case is self-contained with the full quest knowledge base. Entity ids are KINP id/3 terms (koine/specs/identity.md §3.3): a quest of world `alderforest` is id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'q1') — the sanitized _id atom becomes the identifier's local id and the world's CURIE its namespace. Rules project the local id so bindings stay scalar (see conformance/README.md § 'KINP identifiers in the corpus').

cases.name: quest-reward-lookup
kb: quest(id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'q1'), 'Rescue the Merchant', main, easy, active).
quest(id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'q2'), 'Slay the Dragon', main, hard, locked).
objective_complete(Player, Q, Idx) :- completed(Player, Q, Idx).
quest_prerequisite_local(QL, PL) :- quest_prerequisite(id(ent, _, QL), id(ent, _, PL)).
high_value_quest(L) :- quest_reward(id(ent, _, L), gold, G), G >= 200.
